theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_zero_limit_rescale
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne').massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * T.massOn (dilation x lam ⁻¹' W)) ∧ (∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) ω)) ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (mu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 < mu) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), currentEval (blowUp (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') y mu hmu.ne') ω = currentEval (blowUp T (x + lam • y) (lam * mu) (mul_pos hlam hmu).ne') ω) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → ∃ R' : IMRep (dilation x lam '' U) n, R'.Represents (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet s → R'.measure s = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * R.measure (dilation x lam ⁻¹' s)) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (cs : ℕ → Euclid P) (ts : ℕ → ℝ) (hts : ∀ i, 0 < ts i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i) (ts i) (hts i).ne') S → ∃ S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (cs i + ts i • y) (ts i * lam) (mul_pos (hts i) hlam).ne') S' ∧ ∀ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R.Represents S → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents S' ∧ R'.measure = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • R.measure.map (dilation y lam)
